lessons.title: Number games & mental maths
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of number games & mental maths and apply it accurately to unfamiliar tasks.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Fun mathematics develops the same reasoning habits as serious problem solving through games, patterns and puzzles. Mental calculation should remain accurate, while estimation provides a quick plausibility check. Puzzles often reward small representations, symmetry or testing cases. Focus specifically on number games & mental maths. Identify the key concepts, common errors, evidence or performance criteria required, and a repeatable method for improvement. Move from recognition to application: understand the task, perform it carefully, check against the stated criteria, and record the reason for any error.
examples: A Fun with Maths Challenge task on number games & mental maths should begin by identifying the exact clue, form or performance criterion being tested.
Create a new number games & mental maths example with a plausible distractor or common error, then explain the correct response or performance.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Fun with Maths Challenge activity on number games & mental maths using practice questions, a text, oral dialogue, puzzle, writing sample or performance sample as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on number games & mental maths: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent performance on the third with explicit justification or self-check.
independent_practice: Complete three unfamiliar number games & mental maths tasks without viewing the solution first.
Create one new example and complete it using the lesson method.
Review one error or weak performance and state the correction rule.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Fun with Maths Challenge checkpoint on number games & mental maths; target at least six correct or meet the stated performance standard consistently.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Fun with Maths Challenge task demonstrating number games & mental maths and record the evidence or self-assessment used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and repeatable self-correction. Encourage independent performance before intervention. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one concrete action for improving number games & mental maths.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
